data.title: 石阶樱吹雪里的踮脚轻拉
data.location: 老城神社下方的青石樱花阶梯
data.prompt: 1girl, solo, ayachi_nene, dusty blue floral square-neck tea dress, puff sleeves, pearl pendant necklace, white mary janes, standing on stone steps, leaning up, tugging viewer sleeve, closed-mouth shy smile, blush, looking up at viewer, swirling cherry blossom petals, mossy stone stairs, spring wind, soft daylight, from above, medium shot
data.animaCaption: Pausing one step below you on the mossy stone staircase, she lightly tugs the edge of your sleeve and looks up through swirling cherry blossoms with a shy blush. Gentle spring daylight softens the puff sleeves of her dusty blue tea dress.
data.promptProse: Viewed from a slightly elevated angle looking down a weathered stone staircase carpeted with fallen blossoms, Ayachi Nene stands one step below the viewer in a dusty-blue floral French tea dress with square neckline, puff sleeves, and a delicate pearl pendant. Reaching up to timidly tug the cuff of the viewer's sleeve, she gazes upward with bright purple eyes and rose-tinted cheeks while a gust of spring wind sweeps pink cherry petals across the foreground and lifts the ends of her silver hair under soft, diffused afternoon light.
data.story: 山脚的石阶被落花铺得松软。宁宁落后你一级台阶停住脚步，轻轻攥住你的衣袖一角仰起脸，樱花瓣正好擦过她的发带落向阶下——「走慢一点嘛……难得只有我们两个人，我想再多记住一会儿今天。」
